I am growing sorghum on my small plot because it survives the dry spells and floods we sometimes get here in Nsanje. I do not have money to buy fertilizer from the shop, and the government coupons usually go to maize growers, not sorghum. I will plant seed I saved from last year's harvest using my own family's labor, as we have always done. We do not spray chemicals or irrigate — we wait for the rains and pull the weeds by hand.
